comment: C ref: monmove.c m_search_items():1405-1414 skips merchandise on a shk.c costly_spot(). This Minetown variant builds its shops as subrooms, so costly_spot() must find the keeper through the subroom's room number. The hero opens the general store's door, a debug-created gnomish wizard (likes_magic) appears beside it, and the hero teleports away out of line; C leaves the shop's scrolls, spellbooks and ring alone and the gnomish wizard follows the hero. Seed, clock and character chosen independently; the seed was picked for a Minetown with nested shop rooms.
